summary_1line: Victor and Clerval tour England and Scotland as Victor secretly prepares to create the monster’s companion in a remote Orkney island.

image_candidates.scene_text: On a bleak Orkney shore, Victor stands before a ruined hut as waves crash against black rocks under a grey sky.
Inside a dim, squalid hut, Victor works at a cluttered laboratory table, recoiling in disgust at the materials for the new creature.
Victor walks the stony beach at dusk, staring into the roaring ocean while imagining the monster watching him from the darkness.
